title: Predictive Stability Theory: Calibrated Local Forecast Breakdown for Prioritising Single-Cell State Transitions

claims.claim: The recovered isolated PST bundle reports seven behavioural tests passing and a compact suite of 21 runs across three seeds and seven variants, plus smoke and two robustness/transfer runs.
On the recovered synthetic controlled compact benchmark, calibrated PST reports AUROC 0.9744 ± 0.0115, AUPRC 0.9101 ± 0.0320, and Top-K precision 0.8235 ± 0.0519 across seeds 11, 29 and 47.
The recovered raw-expression logistic ablation reports AUROC 0.9968 and AUPRC 0.9882, outperforming the neural PST variant on the synthetic controlled generator.
Validation-only calibration worsened the recovered controlled results: raw versus calibrated AUROC 0.9773 vs 0.9744, AUPRC 0.9261 vs 0.9101, ECE 0.0889 vs 0.1692, and Brier 0.0566 vs 0.0769.
Fixed family-A-to-family-B transfer reports AUROC 0.6577 and AUPRC 0.2877, despite family-B in-domain retraining reporting AUROC 0.9903.

Historical Paul15, Pancreas and Dentate Gyrus headline metrics are not reproduced or endorsed by the recovered release because raw logs, exact dataset versions/checksums and original executable repository state were not mounted.

External biological validation remains blocked until official dataset source/version/licence/checksum, feature matrix, metadata audit, leakage-safe biological split and transition-label contracts are resolved.
